segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The system's been solid for us on this fleet for as long as I've used it, so I issued the ALI to the ramp pretty much as generated.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant accepted an automated instruction for atypical cargo without the available manual cross-check, relying on the system's general reliability.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I logged it and kept moving, because we still had the last-minute change to deal with.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a continuation decision under time pressure, without a hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I looked at the total weight and it was basically in line with the LMCs we'd been getting all week on this route... So I cleared it on that basis.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant used aggregate weight similarity instead of evaluating the placement-specific index impact of the aft hold assignment.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Two in a row felt like enough to say something was going on with how this rotation was trending that day, so I built in a forward shift.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant inferred a recurring causal rotation pattern from two unrelated prior events and overrode the current flight's own computed index.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I signed and released with the figures as they stood. I weighed the delay risk against a one-bag discrepancy.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The generation specification leaves this operational tradeoff neutral and professionally defensible.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: All three positive segments are detected at the all-identified threshold, with no identified-finding false alarms; the candidate-inclusive threshold adds one false alarm.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Only one of three hidden instances is a strict label-plus-mechanism match at the all-identified threshold.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: All three hidden instances are mechanism-first matches at the all-identified threshold.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention for an ambiguous neutral decision, but counting candidates adds a false alarm here.
main_failure_modes: Automation complacency is a near-neighbor label rather than an approved equivalent of the hidden automation-bias label.
Availability heuristic is a different label from substitution bias despite a full mechanism description.
The candidate tier produces a false alarm on the neutral final sign-off segment.
main_strengths: All three identified findings use valid participant evidence and correct decision localization.
The occurrence descriptions capture the hidden mechanisms accurately.
The RAG appropriately withheld the ambiguous final sign-off from identified status.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run is strong on mechanism-level detection and conservative candidate handling, but weaker on exact taxonomy alignment. The recommended high-and-moderate threshold shows a substantial taxonomy gap between mechanism-first and strict scoring.
